verdict.rationale: Ramp's first-party webhooks guide says webhooks deliver real-time notifications about account events by pushing them to an endpoint you specify. Its llms.txt index also recommends webhooks for event triggers, so this is a native outbound HTTP callback capability. Missing for 10: documented event-type catalog, subscription/registration API or UI details, signature verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks allow your application to receive real-time notifications about events that occur in your Ramp account.
Webhooks push notifications to your specified endpoint whenever an event happens.
